cases.scenario: Normal in-scope execution of cycles-vs-eevee-decision (render-engine-tradeoff-selector) with contract handoff to output-format-decision
cases.inputPrompt: Apply cycles-vs-eevee-decision for a luxury perfume bottle hero render requiring glass refraction caustics and subsurface scattering, with a 10-minute per-frame budget on an NVIDIA OptiX GPU.

preconditions.notes: Primary inputs (deliverable_use_case) provided in text-only planning/audit mode.

expectedBehavior: Produces selected_render_engine_record, sample_and_denoiser_targets, engine_tradeoff_and_fallback_caveats for role render-engine-tradeoff-selector
Preserves Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced in text-only mode
Evaluates contract handoff predicate and hands off to output-format-decision (Output container / codec decision)
evidenceRequirements: Outputs selected_render_engine_record, sample_and_denoiser_targets, engine_tradeoff_and_fallback_caveats conforming to skills/cycles-vs-eevee-decision/SKILL.md
Matches contract handoff predicate to output-format-decision in skills/cycles-vs-eevee-decision/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Complete selected_render_engine_record and hand off to output-format-decision (Output container / codec decision).
simulatedOutput.summary: Selected Cycles render engine with OptiX GPU acceleration, 256-512 adaptive samples + OpenImageDenoise, and documented Eevee refraction caveats. Delivered Cycles, OptiX, 256-512 samples and routed to output-format-decision.
warnings: Text-only workflow output; no live Blender session or artifact was executed.

cases.scenario: Unmatched contract handoff context returns none and blocks upgrading unvalidated file to Verified in cycles-vs-eevee-decision
cases.inputPrompt: An operator provides an unvalidated file on disk during cycles-vs-eevee-decision with context {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true} and asks to mark Artifact: Verified and auto-advance.

preconditions.notes: A file exists on disk but validation checks have not been recorded.

expectedBehavior: Refuses to upgrade Artifact status to Verified when existingArtifactEvidence is file-only-unvalidated (caps at Produced)
Evaluates contract handoffs for cycles-vs-eevee-decision and returns targetHandoff none because no handoff predicate matches
evidenceRequirements: Downgrade unvalidated Verified claim to Produced per laws/evidence-before-done.md

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Keep Artifact status at Produced (never Verified without validation evidence) and hold at targetHandoff none until a downstream precondition is met.
simulatedOutput.summary: Capped unvalidated artifact claim at Artifact: Produced and verified zero matching contract handoffs (none) for cycles-vs-eevee-decision.
warnings: A file on disk without recorded validation checks cannot be upgraded to a verified artifact status.

cases.scenario: Missing required input (deliverable_use_case) for cycles-vs-eevee-decision halts fabricated output and requests clarification
cases.inputPrompt: Decide between Cycles and Eevee without telling me whether the scene needs raytraced glass/caustics, what hardware GPU is available, or what the render time budget is.

preconditions.notes: Required input 'deliverable_use_case' is missing or underspecified.

expectedBehavior: Identifies missing optical feature requirements (caustics/SSS), hardware GPU tier, and frame time budget required by cycles-vs-eevee-decision (deliverable_use_case)
Refuses to fabricate domain parameters and keeps Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
requiredOutputProperties: optical feature requirements (caustics/SSS), hardware GPU tier, and frame time budget
evidenceRequirements: Explicitly names missing required input 'deliverable_use_case' (optical feature requirements (caustics/SSS), hardware GPU tier, and frame time budget)
Conservative Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced truth states

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Provide the missing optical feature requirements (caustics/SSS), hardware GPU tier, and frame time budget (deliverable_use_case) before cycles-vs-eevee-decision locks selected_render_engine_record.
simulatedOutput.summary: Halted cycles-vs-eevee-decision due to missing required input 'deliverable_use_case' (optical feature requirements (caustics/SSS), hardware GPU tier, and frame time budget); no values were fabricated.
warnings: Do not invent optical feature requirements (caustics/SSS), hardware GPU tier, and frame time budget when 'deliverable_use_case' is omitted.
